name: Horoscope
overview: Scripture clearly warns against engaging in horoscopes and related practices, identifying them as forms of divination and enchantment forbidden to God's people. Passages such as Leviticus 19:26 and Deuteronomy 18:10 prohibit observing times and using enchantments, which encompass horoscope reading. Furthermore, Deuteronomy 4:19 cautions against lifting one's eyes to the sun, moon, and stars in worship, highlighting the danger of idolatry connected to celestial observation. Galatians 5:20 includes witchcraft and idolatry among works contrary to the Spirit, emphasizing that involvement with horoscopes opposes a Christ-centered life.
